# README artwork

Original blue workflow illustration generated by [the profile source](https://github.com/rifatur17/rifatur17/blob/main/scripts/showcase_panels.py). Desktop/mobile sources and physically static reduced-motion alternatives are local to this repository. Animated states are explanatory artwork, not live telemetry or benchmark evidence. The project documentation following the header is preserved.

To regenerate, use `make(kind, narrow, animated)` from that source for each of the four local SVG variants. The project kind is `energy`.
